verdict.rationale: Jitsu's self-hosted/on-prem deployment model and 'your warehouse is the single source of truth' positioning imply that customers control where data lives and can manage retention/deletion themselves via their own warehouse, and Jitsu Functions can filter/exclude data before it's stored. However, there is no explicit documentation of a built-in data retention policy, TTL setting, or a deletion/right-to-erasure API in Jitsu Cloud. Missing for 10: documented data retention/TTL controls, explicit user-data deletion API or workflow, GDPR/CCPA erasure request handling for cloud-hosted customers.
